# Sourdough starter

A sourdough starter is flour and water that wild yeast and bacteria have made their home. Feed it equal weights of flour and water once a day at room temperature, and it will double in size within a few hours after each feeding. A starter that smells of vinegar is hungry, one that smells of acetone is very hungry. Keep a spoonful in the fridge when you do not bake, and feed it once a week.

See [[Baking/hydration]] and [[Baking/baking-day]].
